glosses: whereabouts (the location where something or someone ends up, with the implication that there was no fixed destination or that it was unknown)
meeting place (place where people routinely meet)

examples.text: Tom mentiu sobre seu paradeiro naquele dia.
examples.en: Tom lied about his whereabouts that day.

examples.text: Os pais deveriam monitorar o paradeiro de seus filhos.
examples.en: Parents should monitor their children's whereabouts.
